onlineOffline.q: Online aur offline course mein kya fark hai?
onlineOffline.a: Dono mein syllabus aur tests same hain. Offline mein classroom padhai, hamare ground par roz physical training, library aur hostel bhi milta hai. Online mein aap ghar se live jud sakte hain aur recordings dekh sakte hain.

demo.q: Kya fees dene se pehle class dekh sakte hain?

material.a: Haan. Offline students ko printed notes aur online students ko PDF notes milte hain, saath mein naye pattern par mock tests.

physical.a: Offline students roz hamare ground par ex-service trainers ke saath training karte hain. Online students ko training plan aur video guidance milti hai.

hostel.a: Haan, offline students ke liye academy ke paas hostel aur mess hai. Yeh course fee mein shaamil nahi hai, iski fees alag se lagti hai; seat aur charges ke liye counsellor se poochein.

fees.q: Kya fees kishton mein de sakte hain?

agniveer-6-month-plan.title: 6 mahine mein Agniveer GD kaise crack karein: month-by-month plan
agniveer-6-month-plan.excerpt: Ek simple plan jo aapke 6 mahine written exam, physical test aur revision mein baant deta hai.
agniveer-6-month-plan.p1: Agniveer GD mein teen padaav hain: written exam, physical fitness test aur medical. Zyaadatar students isliye chook jaate hain kyunki woh inmein se sirf ek ki taiyari karte hain. Pehle din se hi har din ko padhai aur ground ke hisson mein baantein.
agniveer-6-month-plan.p2: Pehle aur doosre mahine mein GK aur maths ke basics poore karein aur aasaan 3 km runs se apna running base banayein. Teesre aur chauthe mahine mein har hafte do mock tests dein aur 1.6 km ke time par kaam karein. Paanchve aur chhathe mahine mein sirf apne notes aur mock test ki galtiyon se revision karein.
agniveer-6-month-plan.p3: Saat ghante soyein, saada khana khaayein aur apni run timing ek notebook mein likhein. Consistency zor se behtar hai: 6 hafte ki kadi mehnat se 6 mahine ka steady plan behtar hai.

police-run-tips.title: Police physical test: lambi daud clear karne ke tips
police-run-tips.excerpt: Pacing, shoes, breathing aur woh weekly schedule jo hamare PT instructors har batch ke saath follow karte hain.
police-run-tips.p1: Police physical test ki daud official notification mein diye time ke andar poori karni hoti hai, isliye pehle use padhein aur hisaab lagayein ki per km kitni pace chahiye. Shuruaat us pace se thoda dheere karein aur sirf aakhri km mein speed badhayein.
police-run-tips.p2: Hafte mein chaar din training karein: ek lambi slow run, ek interval session (400 m repeats), ek chadhai ya seedhiyon ka session aur ek aasaan recovery run. Pairon ki taakat ke liye hafte mein do baar skipping aur squats jodein.
police-run-tips.p3: Halke, sahi naap ke shoes mein daudein jinmein aap pehle se practice kar chuke hon. Test se pehle wale hafte mein naye shoes, naya khana ya naya route kabhi try na karein. Ek rhythm mein saans lein aur kandhe dheele rakhein.

ssc-gd-2026.title: SSC GD Constable: posts, eligibility aur apply kaise karein
ssc-gd-2026.excerpt: SSC GD Constable ka form bharne se pehle 10th pass student ko kya jaanna chahiye.
ssc-gd-2026.p1: SSC GD Constable ke zariye BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP aur SSB jaise central armed police forces mein bharti hoti hai. 10th pass aur age limit ke andar wale candidates SSC website par online apply kar sakte hain.
ssc-gd-2026.p2: Selection ke kai stages hote hain: computer based test, physical efficiency test, physical standard test aur medical. Written test mein reasoning, GK, maths aur Hindi ya English aati hai.
ssc-gd-2026.p3: Apply karne se pehle apne documents ready rakhein: 10th marksheet, photo, signature aur agar ho to caste ya NCC certificate. Dates aur vacancies hamesha SSC ke official notice mein check karein; hamari site par diye figures andaazan hain.

nda-maths-strategy.title: NDA maths: in chapters se shuruaat karein
nda-maths-strategy.excerpt: Agar NDA maths ke liye sirf teen mahine hain, to pehle apna time kahaan lagayein.
nda-maths-strategy.p1: NDA maths paper mein negative marking hoti hai, isliye har chapter cover karne se zyada zaroori speed aur accuracy hai.
nda-maths-strategy.p2: Algebra, trigonometry, calculus aur matrices se aam taur par sabse zyada questions aate hain. Inhi se shuruaat karein, phir coordinate geometry, statistics aur probability par jaayein.
nda-maths-strategy.p3: Exam timing mein kam se kam paanch previous year papers solve karein. Har galat question mark karein aur ek hafte baad use dobara solve karein. Hamara NDA batch har Sunday maths ka timed test leta hai.

budget-diet-plan.title: Defence aspirants ke liye simple aur sasta diet plan
budget-diet-plan.excerpt: Ghar ka khana jo mehenge supplements ke bina subah ki run ke liye energy deta hai.
budget-diet-plan.p1: Physical test clear karne ke liye protein powder zaroori nahi hai. Dal, chana, ande, doodh, dahi, mausami phal aur roti se zyaadatar students ko zaroori protein aur energy mil jaati hai.
budget-diet-plan.p2: Subah ki run se 30 minute pehle kela ya bheega chana jaisa halka snack lein aur run ke baad poora nashta karein. Sirf training ke baad nahi, din bhar paani peete rahein.
budget-diet-plan.p3: Fried snacks, cold drinks aur der raat ka khana kam karein. Neend bhi diet ka hissa hai: saat ghante ki neend ke bina body training se recover nahi kar paati.

success-rohit.title: Etawah ke ek gaon se Agniveer tak: Rohit ki kahani
success-rohit.excerpt: Kaise ek kisaan ke bete ne kheti, padhai aur running ke beech balance banaya aur pehle hi attempt mein Agniveer GD clear kiya.
success-rohit.p1: Rohit Yadav 10th ke baad hamare offline batch mein aaye. Unhone pehle kabhi coaching nahi li thi aur 1.6 km mein unka time kaafi slow tha. Woh har subah class se pehle family ke khet mein haath bantaate the.
success-rohit.p2: Unhone batch plan ko strictly follow kiya: subah 5 baje ground training, dopahar tak classes aur shaam tak library mein self-study. Chaar mahine mein unki run timing do minute se zyada sudhar gayi.
success-rohit.p3: Unhone pehle hi attempt mein Agniveer GD clear kiya. Naye students ko unki salaah: apne roz ke targets kaagaz par likhein aur baarish ke din bhi ground na chhodein.
